children: REGIS CORP reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $224.49M and diluted EPS of $2.41, with net income of $6.94M, reflecting higher revenue but sharply lower profitability versus the prior year.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “income per share, diluted”.
System-wide sales declined year-over-year to $1,066.3M while same-store sales were modestly positive at 0.9%, reflecting mixed brand performance.
Acquisition of 314 Alline salons (261 operating) shifted many franchise locations to company-owned, substantially boosting company-owned revenue.
Company-owned revenue rose about 79% to $78.3M and same-store sales for company-owned salons improved 4.0%, driven by full-year Alline results.
The franchise network contracted by 199 salons to 3,448, reducing royalties, fees, ad contributions and franchise rental income.
General and administrative expenses and accounts-payable efficiencies helped lower expenses, while company-owned operating costs and rent increased with the expanded salon ownership.
